item.title: Trial begins in Miami for four men accused in plot to assassinate Haitian President
item.description: A federal trial in Miami has begun for four men accused of helping plan the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse. Prosecutors say the plot was organized in South Florida and aimed to replace Haiti’s leader with a figure who would grant political influence and lucrative contracts to the conspirators.
